name: Heron Vale
tagline: The last chapter, authored with intention.
positioning: Heron Vale turns end-of-life planning into a living archive — one dignified system for your final wishes, memorial, and legacy.

hero.h1: Compose a farewell worthy of a life fully lived.
hero.sub: Heron Vale is the planning studio for your final chapter — wishes, ceremony, and legacy captured in one serene, secure archive your family can trust.

features.title: The Living Directive
features.description: Record every wish — from music to messages — in a versioned document that updates as you do, and unlocks for the right people at the right moment.

features.title: Ceremony Studio
features.description: Design the service down to the readings, the room, and the light. Share a polished plan with your celebrant and family in a single link.

features.title: Legacy Vault
features.description: Deposit letters, recordings, and documents into an encrypted vault with timed release — words that arrive exactly when they are needed.

features.title: Guided Estate Map
features.description: Trace accounts, keepsakes, and instructions onto one clear map, so nothing meaningful is lost in the paperwork of grief.

features.title: Trusted Circle
features.description: Name your executors and confidants with granular permissions, revocable anytime, so your plans are protected yet never orphaned.

features.title: Provider Concierge
features.description: Compare vetted funeral homes and services with transparent pricing, then hand over a complete brief instead of a blank page.

testimonials.quote: I sat with my mother's Heron Vale archive after she passed and felt her hand on every decision. There was nothing to guess at — only her intentions, beautifully clear.
testimonials.name: Marguerite Odell

testimonials.quote: As a celebrant I receive plans from every corner of the country. A Heron Vale brief is the only one I open knowing the family and I already agree on everything.
testimonials.name: Desmond Fairweather

testimonials.quote: We recommend Heron Vale to every family we serve. It ends the frantic search through drawers and turns pre-planning into something people actually want to finish.
testimonials.name: Priya Anand

pricing.blurb: Capture your essential wishes and keep them current.
The full studio for a farewell composed with intention.
For families and advisors managing multiple archives.

homepage.footerBlurb: Heron Vale is the planning studio for life's final chapter — dignified, secure, and made to be shared when it matters most.
